```{r functions, include=FALSE,echo=F,message=F}
add_continent <- function(df, country_col) {
  # Define countries
  asia_countries <- c("BGD","CHN","IND","IRN","MYS","PAK","VNM")
  other_countries <- c("YEM","HTI","PER")
  
  df %>% 
    mutate(continent = case_when(admin_level != "regional" & !!rlang::sym(country_col) %in% asia_countries ~ "Asia",
                                 admin_level != "regional" & !!rlang::sym(country_col) %in% other_countries ~ "Other",
                                 admin_level != "regional" ~ "Africa",
                                 admin_level == "regional" & str_detect(!!rlang::sym(country_col), str_c(asia_countries, collapse = "|")) ~ "Asia",
                                 admin_level == "regional" & str_detect(!!rlang::sym(country_col), str_c(other_countries, collapse = "|")) ~ "Other",
                                 TRUE ~ "Africa")
    )
}

count_countries_single <- function(df,
                                   all_isocodes) {
  map_df(all_isocodes, function(x) {
    count <- map_lgl(df$country_list, ~ x %in% .)
    tibble(country = x,
           count = sum(count))
  })
}

count_countries <- function(df, 
                            all_isocodes,
                            group_col = NULL) {
  
  if (!("country_list" %in% colnames(df))) {
    stop("First extract country list")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(group_col)) {
    df %>% 
      group_by_at(group_col) %>% 
      group_modify(function(x, y) {
        count_countries_single(df = x,
                               all_isocodes = all_isocodes) 
      })
  } else {
    count_countries_single(df = df,
                           all_isocodes = all_isocodes)
  }
}

char_to_date <- function(x) {
  out <- vector(length =  length(x))
  
  for (i in 1:length(x)) {
    if (!str_detect(x[i], "[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")) {
      out[i] <- as.Date(as.numeric(as.character(x[i])), origin = "1899-12-30") %>% as.character()
    } else {
      out[i] <- x[i] %>% str_replace_all("00", "01")
    }
  }
  as.Date(out)
}
```

```{r load data, include =FALSE,echo=F,message=F}
dat_path <- here::here("Data/cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets.xlsx")
dat_path <- "C:/Users/zheng/Cholera/cholera_climate_review/Data/cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets.xlsx"

# Load effect extraction data ----
est_data <- readxl::read_excel(dat_path, sheet = "estimates_0329")%>%
  # Fix dates
  mutate(across(c("eff_tl", "eff_tr"), ~ char_to_date(.))) %>% 
  # Unpack countries for multi-country studies
  mutate(country_list = purrr::map(eff_country, ~ str_split(., pattern = "\\|")[[1]])) %>% 
  # Fix estimates
  mutate(across(c("a_effect", "a_uncert_lb", "a_uncert_ub"), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>% 
  # Fix classes of estimates
  mutate(a_class = case_when(str_detect(a_raw, "correlation") ~ "correlation",
                             a_class == "correlation" & !str_detect(a_class, "correlation") ~ "other",
                             TRUE ~ a_class))  %>%
  # Se ratio to log10 ratio for plots
  mutate(a_effect = case_when(a_class == "ratio" ~ log10(a_effect),
                              TRUE ~ a_effect),
         a_class = case_when(a_class == "ratio" ~ "log10_ratio",
                             TRUE ~ a_class)) %>% 
  # Levels
  mutate(a_direction = factor(a_direction, levels = c("negative", "none", "positive", "not stated"))) %>%
  # Spatial scales
  mutate(
    admin_level = case_when(eff_admin == "adm0" ~ "national", 
                            str_detect(eff_admin, "[1-4]") ~ "sub-national",
                            str_detect(eff_country, "\\|") | str_detect(eff_country, "multi") ~ "regional",
                            TRUE ~ "sub-national"),
    admin_level = factor(admin_level, levels = c("regional", "national", "sub-national", "other"))
  ) %>% 
  add_continent(country_col = "eff_country")
```

```{r compute scores, include =T,echo=F,message=F}
scores <- est_data[,colnames(est_data) %in% c("studykey","eff_country","exp_class","exp_temp_scale","exp_spatial_scale","exp_source","out_class_metric","out_class_case_presentation","out_medicattended","out_temp_scale","out_spatial_scale","case_def_raw","exp_out_spatial_scale_match","a_effect","a_adjusted","a_uncert_def")] %>% 
  mutate(
    #3 exposures
    exp_temp_tf = ifelse(exp_temp_scale == 99,FALSE,TRUE),
    exp_spatial_tf = ifelse(exp_spatial_scale == "not stated",FALSE,TRUE),
    exp_source_tf = ifelse(exp_source == "not stated",FALSE,TRUE),
    
    #5 outcomes
    out_class_metric_tf = ifelse(out_class_metric == "not stated", FALSE, TRUE),
    out_class_case_presentation_tf = ifelse(out_class_case_presentation == "not stated",FALSE,TRUE),
    out_medicattended_tf = ifelse(out_medicattended == "not stated", FALSE,TRUE),
    out_temp_tf = ifelse(out_temp_scale == 99,FALSE,TRUE),
    out_spatial_tf = ifelse(out_spatial_scale == "not stated",FALSE,TRUE),

    #4 association effects
    a_effect_tf = ifelse(is.na(a_effect),FALSE,TRUE),
    a_adjusted_tf = ifelse(a_adjusted == "not stated",FALSE,TRUE),
    a_uncert_def_tf = ifelse(a_uncert_def == "not stated",FALSE,TRUE),
    a_match_tf = ifelse(exp_out_spatial_scale_match == "unknown",FALSE,TRUE)
    
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tot_score = exp_temp_tf + exp_spatial_tf + exp_source_tf + out_class_case_presentation_tf + out_spatial_tf + out_temp_tf + out_class_metric_tf + out_medicattended_tf + a_match_tf + a_adjusted_tf + a_uncert_def_tf +a_effect_tf
  )
```

```{r manuscript figure4, include =T,fig.width=7, fig.height=9,echo=F,message=F}
sum_scores_long <- scores %>% 
  group_by(studykey) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(studykey, contains("_tf")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("tf"),
               names_to = "what",
               values_to = "score") %>% 
  group_by(studykey) %>% 
  mutate(exp_score = sum(score[str_detect(what, "exp")], na.rm = T),
         out_score = sum(score[str_detect(what, "out")], na.rm = T),
         a_score = sum(score[str_detect(what, "a_")], na.rm = T),
         tot_score = sum(score, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(across(contains("_score"), function(x) {x == max(x)})) %>% 
  select(studykey, contains("_")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(est_data %>% distinct(studykey, continent)) %>% 
  select(studykey, continent, contains("_")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("_score"))  %>% 
  mutate(what = case_when(name == "tot_score" ~ "overall",
                          TRUE ~ "categories")) 


score_dict <- c("tot_score" = "total score",
                "exp_score" = "exposure",
                "out_score" = "outcome",
                "a_score" = "association effect")  

colors_scores <- c(c("#F5C662"), "#803CE6")

p_figure_4 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  sum_scores_long %>% 
    filter(what == "overall") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = continent, fill = value)) +
    geom_bar() +
    facet_grid(. ~ name, labeller = labeller(name = score_dict)) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_scores) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend("Full score")) +
    coord_flip(),
  sum_scores_long %>% 
    filter(what != "overall") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = continent, fill = value)) +
    geom_bar() +
    facet_grid(name ~ ., labeller = labeller(name = score_dict)) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_scores) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    coord_flip(),
  nrow = 2,
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr",
  labels = "auto",
  rel_heights = c(.5, 1))

ggsave(p_figure_4, filename = "figures/figure_4.png", 
       width = 7, height = 9, dpi = 300)

cowplot::plot_grid(
  sum_scores_long %>% 
    filter(what == "overall") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = continent, fill = value)) +
    geom_bar() +
    facet_grid(. ~ name, labeller = labeller(name = score_dict)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
          legend.position = "right",
          plot.margin = unit(c(2, 1, 1, 1), units = "lines"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_scores) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend("Full score")) +
    coord_flip(),
  sum_scores_long %>% 
    filter(what != "overall") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = continent, fill = value)) +
    geom_bar() +
```

```{r manuscript tables, include =TRUE,fig.width=14,fig.height=6,echo=F,message=F}
total_hist_data <- scores %>% 
  group_by(studykey) %>% 
  mutate(total_est = n()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = exp_temp_tf:a_match_tf, 
    names_to = "question",
    values_to = "value"
) %>% 
  mutate(quality_category = ifelse(
    question %in% c("exp_temp_tf", "exp_spatial_tf", "exp_source_tf", "out_temp_tf", "out_spatial_tf", "out_class_metric_tf", "out_medicattended_tf", "a_effect_tf", "a_uncert_def_tf"), "reporting quality",ifelse(question == "out_class_case_presentation_tf","reporting quality\ninternal validity","internal validity")
  ),
  question_category = ifelse(
    question %in% c("exp_temp_tf", "exp_spatial_tf", "exp_source_tf"),"exposure",
    ifelse(
      question %in% c("out_temp_tf", "out_spatial_tf", "out_class_metric_tf", "out_medicattended_tf","out_class_case_presentation_tf"),"outcome","association effect"
    )
  ),
      continent = ifelse(
      eff_country %in% c("BGD","CHN","IND","IRN","MYS","PAK","VNM"),"Asia",
      ifelse(
        eff_country %in% c("YEM","HTI","PER"), "Other","Africa"
      )
    )
  )

# summary table for the quality of the paper by theme
## part1 total score distribution across all studies
tot_score_table <- total_hist_data %>% 
  group_by(studykey) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_score = mean(tot_score)
  )

## part2 total score distribution across all studies and questions
question_score_table <- total_hist_data %>% 
  group_by(studykey,question) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_score = mean(value)
  )
  
## part3 total score distribution across all studies and question category
question_cat_score_table <- total_hist_data %>% 
  group_by(studykey,question_category) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_score = sum(value)/unique(total_est)
  )

## part4 total score distribution across all studies and quality category
pre_quality_score_table <- total_hist_data %>% 
  group_by(studykey,quality_category,question,total_est) %>% 
  summarize(
    mean_value = mean(value)
  )

quality_score_table <- pre_quality_score_table %>% 
  mutate(quality_category = ifelse(question == "out_class_case_presentation_tf","internal validity",quality_category)) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    pre_quality_score_table %>% 
      filter(question == "out_class_case_presentation_tf") %>% 
      mutate(quality_category = "reporting quality")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(studykey,quality_category) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_score = sum(mean_value)/unique(total_est)
  )

## part5 total score distribution across all studies and continent
continent_score_table <- total_hist_data %>%
```

```{r Extracted estiamtes summaries,fig.height=8,fig.width=10,echo=F,message=F}
est_data_tmp <- est_data[,colnames(est_data)%in%c("studykey","eff_country","exp_class","a_raw","a_class","a_effect","a_adjusted","a_direction","a_uncert_def","a_uncert_significant","a_statmethod","a_uncert_lb","a_uncert_ub")]

#correct the invalid text in cells
est_data_tmp$a_statmethod[c(226,229)] <- "Assuming that the whole population was exposed to the environmental factors, the attributable risk (AR) was calculated using the formula AR = RR minus 1 divides RR"

# correlation coefficient
cor_cof <- est_data_tmp %>% 
  filter(a_class == "correlation coefficient") %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_a_class = ifelse(str_detect(a_statmethod,"Coefficient of determination|Ordinary Least Squares regression|coefficient of determination|Generalized Additive Modeling
"),"coefficient of determination",
      ifelse(str_detect(a_statmethod, "autoregression|SARIMA"),"autoregression coefficient", 
             ifelse(str_detect(a_statmethod, "causality"), "causality coefficient",
                    ifelse(str_detect(a_statmethod, "regression|Regression"),"correlation coefficient","correlation coefficient"))))) %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_a_class = ifelse(a_statmethod == "Ordinary Least Squares regression" & str_detect(a_raw,"correlation coefficient"),"correlation coefficient",ifelse(str_detect(a_statmethod,"didn't state the specific model"),"unknown regression coefficient",analytic_a_class))) %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_a_effect = as.numeric(a_effect)
  )

new_cor_cof <- cor_cof %>% 
  mutate(
    continent = ifelse(
      eff_country %in% c("BGD","CHN","IND","IRN","MYS","PAK","VNM"),"Asia",
      ifelse(
        eff_country %in% c("YEM","HTI","PER"), "Other","Africa"
      )
    )
  )

# ratio
## odds ratio, relative ratio, risk ratio
ratio <- est_data_tmp %>% 
  filter(a_class == "ratio") %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_a_class = ifelse(str_detect(a_raw,"odd|Odds"),"odds ratio",
                              ifelse(str_detect(a_raw,"incidence"),"incidence rate ratio",
                                     ifelse(str_detect(a_raw,"log"),"log risk ratio","relative risk ratio")))) %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_a_class = ifelse(a_raw == "incidence rate ratio in log scale","log incidence rate ratio",
                              ifelse(str_detect(a_statmethod,"Poisson|poisson"),"incidence rate ratio",analytic_a_class))) %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_a_effect = ifelse(analytic_a_class %in% c("log incidence rate ratio","log risk ratio"),exp(as.numeric(a_effect)),as.numeric(a_effect))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    analytic_a_class = ifelse(analytic_a_class == "log incidence rate ratio","incidence rate ratio", ifelse(analytic_a_class == "log risk ratio","relative risk ratio",analytic_a_class))
  )

new_ratio <- ratio %>% 
  mutate(
    continent = ifelse(
      eff_country %in% c("BGD","CHN","IND","IRN","MYS","PAK","VNM"),"Asia",
      ifelse(
        eff_country %in% c("YEM","HTI","PER"), "Other","Africa"
      )
    )
  )

# other association effects
## attributable risk, 
other_cof <- est_data_tmp %>% 
  filter(a_class %in% c("attributable risk","other","risk difference")) %>% 
  mutate(analytic_a_class = a_class) %>% 
  mutate(analytic_a_effect = as.numeric(a_effect))

new_other_cof <- other_cof %>% 
  mutate(
    continent = ifelse(
      eff_country %in% c("BGD","CHN","IND","IRN","MYS","PAK","VNM"),"Asia",
      ifelse(
        eff_country %in% c("YEM","HTI","PER"), "Other","Africa"
      )
    )
  )

new_est <- rbind(new_cor_cof,new_ratio,new_other_cof)

# table
new_est %>% 
  group_by(exp_class) %>% 
  summarise(
    `Number of estimates with positive direction` = length(a_direction[a_direction=="positive"]),
    `Number of estimates with negative direction` = length(a_direction[a_direction=="negative"]),
    `Number of papers with positive direction` = length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="positive"])),
    `Number of papers with negative direction` = length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="negative"])),
    `Prop of papers with the \nsame finding in positive association\n(agreement)` = round(length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="positive"]))/(length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="positive"]))+length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="negative"]))),2),
    `Prop of sigf positive estimates` = round(length(a_direction[a_direction=="positive" & a_uncert_significant==TRUE])/n(),2),
    `Prop of sigf negative estimates` = round(length(a_direction[a_direction=="negative" & a_uncert_significant==TRUE])/n(),2)

  ) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Table 9. Summary of the direction of the association effect by exposure category") %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) 

new_est %>% 
  group_by(exp_class,a_class) %>% 
  summarise(
    `Number of estimates with positive direction` = length(a_direction[a_direction=="positive"]),
    `Number of estimates with negative direction` = length(a_direction[a_direction=="negative"]),
    `Number of papers with positive direction` = length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="positive"])),
    `Number of papers with negative direction` = length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="negative"])),
    `Percent of papers with the \nsame finding in positive association\n(agreement)` = round(length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="positive"]))/(length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="positive"]))+length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="negative"]))),2)
  ) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Table 10. Summary of the direction of the association effect by association effect type and exposure category") %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) 

#histogram
new_est_hist <- new_est %>% 
  group_by(exp_class,a_class) %>% 
  summarise(
    `Number of papers with positive direction` = length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="positive"])),
    `Number of papers with negative direction` = length(unique(studykey[a_direction=="negative"])),
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `Number of papers with positive direction`:`Number of papers with negative direction`, 
    names_to = "direction",
    values_to = "Number of papers") 

new_est_hist%>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = exp_class,y=`Number of papers`,fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",position = position_dodge()) + 
  ggtitle("Figure 8. Distribution of the directions of association effects by exposure category")

new_est_sd <- new_est %>% 
  group_by(exp_class,a_class,studykey) %>% 
  summarise(
    within_study_sd = sd(a_effect,na.rm=T)
  )
```
